sign.name: Symbol
sign.operation: Low wide of Athena and Odysseus beneath the olive; insert of its trunk; the same trunk framing returns for the bed in XXIII.

scenes.world: A dim limestone sea cave and a single ancient olive tree on a misty Mediterranean hillside in soft grey light.

captain.asks: Plant the olive as a symbol: low wide of the two beneath it, then its trunk in insert, so the bed in XXIII can rhyme.
diagnosis: The olive never gets its two people: tree shots are empty and people shots have no tree; the symbol doesn't bind.
Sepia and brown-tinted frames haunt every row; refusing them keeps bw, but the cave light swings from desert glare to kitchen dark.
Best moments are the hand-drawn plan and the stone circle: planning is legible, concealment is not.

sign.name: Limpid and opaque
sign.operation: Replacement on twos as the wand touches him: skin, hair, eyes, rags swapped one element at a time in one held medium.

scenes.world: A misty rocky hillside above a cove in flat grey morning light, the same olive and stone, one held frame of transformation.

captain.asks: Swap one element at a time in one held grey medium: hand, hair, eyes, rags, until the king is a beggar the woman leaves behind.
diagnosis: The transformation has no body to happen to: hands, eyes and faces belong to different strangers, so nothing is replaced, only shuffled.
The colour turbaned old man and the colour bearded man flood every row; refusing them keeps the medium but leaves the beggar thin.
Goddess and wand are never seen; the touch that drives the scene exists only in the voice.

prologue: Odysseus, king of the island of Ithaca, has been away twenty years: ten at war, ten lost at sea. Now a friendly people finally ship him home, but his house is overrun by men who court his wife and eat his wealth. He must come back in secret.
